text: 1. The page with personal information in the ordinary passport (the expiry date should after September 30th, 2025) (Applicants in mainland China also need to submit the copy of the current valid visa page or residence permit page)2.Highest Education Diploma or Certificate of expected graduation date from the high school studying currently can also be accepted (the original high school graduation certificate will be verified at the time of registration)3. The transcripts that covers all subjects in the period of high school4. Foreigner Physical Examination Form and the Report on Blood Examination within the validity period of 6 months (Applicant need to download the Foreigner Physical Examination Form and go to the local regular medical institution to conduct physical examination according to the items listed in the form. The examination results should be filled in Chinese/English, signed and sealed by the doctor and medical institution) Click here to download "Foreigner Physical Examination Form "5. The results of TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or English Proficiency Certificate for the applicant whose native language is not English (90 or above in TOEFL, 6 or above in IELTS, 105 or above in Duolingo)6. Financial guarantor letter Click here to download the template of "Financial Guarantee Letter"7. Financial guarantor proof (bank deposit of no less than 4 years tuition fee or annual income of no less than 30000 RMB)8. Birth certificate of the applicant9. The documentation of the nationality of the applicant's parents when applicant birth (including passport, ID card, the proof of permanent resident abroad, etc.)10. The certificate of Non-Criminal Record within the validity period of 6 months issued by the local public security authority11. An Integrity Commitment Letter to ensure the authenticity of all the application materials you provide Click here to download the Integrity Commitment Letter template12. Applicants under the age of 18 till September 1, 2025 should submit the notarial certificate of Guardian's Guarantee. The guardian should be an adult who lives in Beijing with financial resources. Click here to download Procedure of Guardian Notarization Documents for the Applicant under the Age of 1813. Other documents required by Beihang University
